picks.headline: Meet Martini: A Film Set for AI Video That Aims to Help Filmmakers Streamline Their Shots
picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the fresh pool: a new, shipping web platform that replaces prompt roulette with a shared 2D/3D pre-production 'film set' for AI video, with a free indie tier that lowers the barrier for small crews tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Martini is a collaborative, web-based platform pitched as a 'film set' for AI video: filmmakers upload their own sets and reference images or generate them, then compose shots in 2D or 3D environments to escape prompt roulette and give crews a shared pre-production hub. Out now with a free indie tier and paid plans from $15/month.
